signals.evidence: Current gross margins are 20.57% and revenue growth is 21.9% YoY. This indicates that gross margins are below the 25% threshold while revenue growth is above 15%, suggesting demand may be passing through to customers rather than being captured by GEV, approaching the falsification condition for moat capture.
